summary: The main risk today is the earnings calendar. Eight names have estimated reports within 5 trading days (MCO and WDFC tomorrow, SAM and VRSN on 10-22, DORM on 10-26, and EXLS, INCY and LOGI on 10-27), and the only notable 8-K item is a 5.02 officer change at SMG. Most company-specific news is about AAPL (a Loop downgrade to Hold, an Oct 28 product event, earnings likely Nov 2, and EU/UK regulatory pressure). MSCI and MLI already reported this morning, and KR reaffirmed guidance and set long-term targets. Earnings dates are estimates (last year's date + 364 days) unless noted.

notable.headline: Loop Capital Downgrades Apple to Hold, Lowers Price Target to $330
notable.read: A sell-side downgrade right before a busy catalyst stretch (Oct 28 MacBook Pro event, Nov 2 earnings) with market cap above $5T. It is a counterweight to the strong iPhone Duo demand reports (82-day lead times).

notable.headline: UK CMA proposals on iPhone contactless access; Poland orders App Tracking Transparency changes
notable.read: Regulatory pressure in Europe is piling up on services and fees. Neither is immediately material, but the direction is negative for platform economics.

notable.headline: Apple Commits Up To $100M With American Manufacturing Program Partner Perryman for iPhone Duo Titanium
notable.read: A small dollar amount; mainly signals onshoring and tariff positioning. Combined with the Russia tariff waiver it modestly lowers tariff overhang.

notable.headline: Kroger Sets 7%-11% Annual EPS Growth Target Through 2029, Reaffirms 2026 Outlook
notable.read: Investor-day update (8-K 7.01): FY26 guidance of $5.10-$5.30 brackets the $5.21 consensus, and the multi-year targets give clearer visibility. A stabilizing development, not a surprise.

notable.headline: MSCI Q3 Adj. EPS $5.11 Beats $5.02 Estimate, Sales $892M Beat
notable.read: A clean beat on both EPS and revenue; the earnings risk is behind it.

notable.headline: Mueller Industries Q3 EPS $1.00 Misses $1.05 Estimate, Sales $1.419B Beat $1.285B Estimate
notable.read: Mixed print: a big revenue beat (likely copper pricing) but an EPS miss points to margin pressure.

notable.headline: Evercore raises PT to $130; Deutsche Bank upgrade; Walmart+/Sam's Club bundle at $120/year
notable.read: Sell-side momentum is clustering positively (BofA also reiterated Buy on ad revenue). The membership bundle supports recurring revenue. Earnings around 11-19 (estimate).

notable.headline: JP Morgan Maintains Underweight on Clorox, Lowers Price Target to $83
notable.read: Continued bearish sell-side stance going into estimated earnings on 11-02.

notable.headline: UBS Maintains Buy on Tapestry, Lowers Price Target to $200
notable.read: The rating holds, but the target cut trims expected upside ahead of earnings around 11-05.

notable.headline: Evercore ISI Group Upgrades Match Group to Outperform, Raises Price Target to $53
notable.read: A rating change rather than a routine PT tweak; a positive sentiment shift ahead of earnings around 11-03.

notable.headline: Instacart agrees to $5M settlement with U.S. authorities over PERM recruitment discrimination
notable.read: Financially immaterial; headline risk only. A separate story tags CART about a grocery-chain cyber incident, but it doesn't say Instacart is directly involved.
